visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with an exterior shot of a modern brick building in Seoul. A large vertical billboard featuring two female models in fashionable attire is mounted on the wall alongside a prominent 'GLOWNY' brand sign. A black Mercedes G-Class SUV is parked in the foreground. A young woman in a denim skirt walks past the camera. (2) A quick montage of celebrity images (Jennie and Lisa) appears, showcasing them wearing the brand's apparel in various lifestyle and magazine-style settings. (3) The scene shifts to the interior of the GLOWNY flagship store. The camera pans across wooden shelving units displaying handbags, small glassware, and a white knit top with a blue star. (4) Close-up shots highlight denim jeans with the 'GLOWNY' logo embroidered in white script across the back pockets and various clothing items on hangers, including a blue tiered dress and a star-patterned knit top. (5) In a different section of the store, white mannequins are dressed in basic tops and overalls. A white bathtub is used as a creative display for boxed products and light blue loungewear. (6) A man is seen sitting on a white sofa near a large floor-to-ceiling window, looking at his phone. The area is bright with natural daylight. (7) The camera moves to the second floor, which is more spacious and decorated with large cacti and industrial-chic lighting. Racks of activewear and a vintage suitcase displaying pink bikinis are shown. (8) Detailed close-ups show patterned scrunchies on a book and a small cream-colored plush bear with a 'GLOWNY' star tag. (9) The narrator performs a mirror selfie wearing a white star-patterned knit top and black pants. (10) A close-up shows hands writing a name on a heart-shaped paper tag. The video concludes with the narrator holding a large white shopping bag with the brand name in the mirror.
